name: Jump High For Brainrots
desc:
Welcome to Jump To Steal Brainrots! 🧠⬆️

✨ Leap into the air and collect brainrots as they appear!
💸 Return them to your base to earn cash
🔋 Boost your jump power to go even higher!
🏗️ Upgrade your base to hold more brainrots!

💤 You Earn Money Offline!

Don’t forget to like 👍 and favorite ⭐ the game for future updates! 🚀
